title: Exponential-Wrapped Mechanisms for Differential Privacy on Hadamard Manifolds

contributions.purpose: 将差分隐私(DP)的多种变体扩展到 Hadamard 流形(完备、单连通、非正截面曲率的黎曼流形),填补此前仅有 ε-DP 或受限于特定流形/常曲率的空白
contributions.mechanism: 受 Cartan-Hadamard 定理启发,构造 Exponential-Wrapped Laplace 与 Gaussian 机制,分别校准实现 ε-DP、(ε,δ)-DP、Gaussian DP(GDP)、Rényi DP(RDP);并针对发布差分隐私 Fréchet 均值推导理论 utility 界
contributions.evaluation: 作者声称是首个将 (ε,δ)-DP、GDP、RDP 扩展到 Hadamard 流形的工作,也是 RDP 的首次流形扩展(定性 novelty 声明,含理论 utility bounds)
contributions.domain: 差分隐私 / 黎曼几何(流形数据)
contributions.source_quote: We are the first to extend $(\varepsilon ,δ)$-DP, GDP, and RDP to Hadamard Riemannian manifolds through the introduction of Exponential-Wrapped Laplace and Gaussian mechanisms. Importantly, this is the first extension for RDP and broadens the scope of privacy frameworks to general manifold settings.

contributions.purpose: 避免 Riemannian Laplace/Gaussian 机制所需的高计算量 MCMC 采样,使流形上 DP 更实用
contributions.mechanism: 为 Exponential-Wrapped 机制设计简单直接的快速采样算法,绕开 MCMC 及其调参/诊断
contributions.evaluation: Table 1:在 SPDM 空间 d=15 时,Riemannian Laplace(burn-in 10000)平均 1.54s,而 EWL 4.06e-3s、EWG 3.78e-3s,约快 500 倍
contributions.source_quote: We develop fast and efficient implementations of these mechanisms that avoid the computationally intensive MCMC sampling methods. This development facilitates more feasible and practical applications of differential privacy in real-world scenarios.

contributions.purpose: 实证验证 Exponential-Wrapped 机制的效用(utility)相对传统机制的表现
contributions.mechanism: 在对称正定矩阵(SPDM)流形上以发布 DP Fréchet 均值为任务,固定 n=40,变化隐私预算与维度 d,重复 100 次比较与 Riemannian Laplace 的 Riemannian 距离误差;并补充 OCTMNIST(MedMNIST)真实数据实验
contributions.evaluation: 结果与 Riemannian Laplace 相当;GDP 下 Exponential Gaussian 在小隐私预算时更优;但随维度 d 增大 EWL 相对 Riemannian Laplace 性能退化(体积畸变加剧)
contributions.domain: 隐私机制效用评估(SPDM 医学影像数据)
contributions.source_quote: Through comprehensive numerical experiments, our results demonstrate that our mechanisms perform comparably to the traditional Riemannian Laplace mechanism. Notably, when achieving GDP, our Exponential Gaussian mechanism exhibits superior performance in scenarios with small privacy budgets.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The differential privacy framework was first extended to general manifolds by Reimherr et al. (2021), who introduced the Riemannian Laplace mechanism on Riemannian manifolds to achieve ε-DP.

Utpala et al. (2023a) extended (ε,δ)-DP only to a specific manifold—the Symmetric Positive Definite Matrices (SPDM) space—using the log-Euclidean metric instead of the usual Rao-Fisher affine invariant metric ... In a similar vein, Jiang et al. (2023) expanded Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) to general manifolds, although their calibration algorithm is confined to constant curvature spaces and demands considerable computational resources.

notes: 效用上主要是 comparable(与 Riemannian Laplace 持平),仅在 GDP + 小隐私预算时才更优,主要卖点是计算速度(~500x)。明确 trade-off/caveat:随流形维度 d 增大,EWL 相对 Riemannian Laplace 性能退化,因体积畸变(volume distortion)加剧,其效用优势仅保留于非齐次(non-homogeneous)流形;Riemannian Laplace 在小 μ 时结果不稳定但需精细调 proposal 分布。决定为 reject。
